literature_name: Coprobacillus (Coprobacillus catenaformis, also written Coprobacillus cateniformis)
name_note: The genus holds a single species, written Coprobacillus cateniformis in GTDB and NCBI and Coprobacillus catenaformis in its original description.

sentences.text: The genus Coprobacillus was proposed for three Eubacterium-like, non-spore-forming rods isolated from human faeces, with the single species Coprobacillus catenaformis.
Those strains showed a specific phylogenetic association with Clostridium ramosum and Clostridium spiroforme and had G+C contents of 32.1 to 33.1 mol%.

A study reported that intestinal abundance of Coprobacillus cateniformis decreased in patients with irritable bowel syndrome after faecal microbiota transplantation, correlating with symptom and fatigue severity.
A review lists Coprobacillus cateniformis among bacteria reported to be closely associated with resistance to anti-tumour immunotherapy.
